variants.name: Loose scree
variants.atmosphere: An irregular scatter of stone with open ground between deposits. The least structured and easiest to cross.

variants.name: Narrow benches
variants.atmosphere: Single broken stone benches with two clear rows between them. Long open aisles make the old excavation pattern easy to read.

variants.name: Broad shelves
variants.atmosphere: Two-cell stone shelves separated by three clear rows. Denser groups of rock alternate with generous walking lanes.
